title: Coefficient naturality of the scheme--Galois Frobenius comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and a fixed algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X_0$ be a finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\Phi$ and $g=g_\gamma$ be respectively its $k$-linear $q$-power scheme Frobenius and geometric Galois Frobenius of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. Let $u:A\to B$ be any unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings annihilated by integers prime to $p$. Write $D_R=D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant $R$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and $T:D_A\to D_B$, $T(K)=K\otimes_A^LB$, for ordinary derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For an endomorphism $h:X\to X$, use the inverse pullback coefficient comparison of [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback] (1),
$$
c_{h,K}:Lh_B^*(TK)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(Lh_A^*K),
$$
transported to ordinary constant coefficients through [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant, lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-ring-constant]. For $R=A,B$ let
$\kappa_R^{(m)}:L(\Phi^m)_R^*\xrightarrow{\sim}L(g^m)_R^*$, $m\geq1$, be the specified multiplicative comparison of [prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison], using its canonical absolute-Frobenius trivialization, rather than an arbitrary natural isomorphism between these functors. Then, for every $m\geq1$ and every $K\in D_A$,
$$
T(\kappa^{(m)}_{A,K})\circ c_{\Phi^m,K}
=c_{g^m,K}\circ\kappa^{(m)}_{B,TK}
$$
as morphisms $L(\Phi^m)_B^*(TK)\to T(L(g^m)_A^*K)$ in $D_B$. In particular this includes $\kappa_R=\kappa_R^{(1)}$. No flatness or finite Tor-amplitude hypothesis on $B$ as an $A$-module, or on $K$, is required.
